reviewer: claude-opus-5 acting as the joshi pump-discovery deputy, autonomously, without Ember present
rationale: REFUSED, and the refusal is the finding. The shape above is the exact structural signature of one real acquisition (acq:pump-api:aa47977575a5c7fab82dae8476b1df1a:1787368483698564-50560999195dbcc2a06a18457cbdac5e, GET /coins?limit=3, 2026-08-22T03:14Z, HTTP 200, three rows). The document is a BARE top-level JSON array of coin records: no envelope, no total, no cursor, so this route asserts nothing about completeness and this review promotes no completeness claim. WHY IT IS REFUSED RATHER THAN PROMOTED: this route's rows are HETEROGENEOUS, and schema_fingerprint collapses every array element onto the single pointer $/*, so the document fingerprint is the UNION of the key sets of whichever coins happened to land in the page. It is therefore a function of the page's CONTENTS, not of the route's schema. Measured: eleven successful reads of this route on 2026-08-22 produced EIGHT DISTINCT FINGERPRINTS. Two byte-identical requests taken ninety-seven seconds apart (limit=70, offset=0, sort=last_trade_timestamp, order=DESC) differed by exactly three lines, $/*/cto_address:string, $/*/cto_username:string and $/*/cto_profile_image:string, because one page contained a coin with a community takeover recorded and the other did not. Over those eleven bodies fifty-four shape lines were present in every one and fourteen more appeared in some and not others: banner_uri, cto_address, cto_profile_image, cto_username, indexed_by_pump, inverted, is_charity, king_of_the_hill_timestamp, last_reply, market_id, mayhem_state, pump_swap_pool, raydium_pool and video_uri. Pinning any single fingerprint would build a gate that admits roughly one read in eight and rejects the rest for no provider-side reason at all, and the first person to see that happen would be tempted to widen the review to shapes nobody has ever seen. That temptation is the failure this gate exists to prevent, so the route stays quarantined until the trust predicate can express a REQUIRED leaf set with a closed set of optional leaves rather than one whole-document digest. The exact bytes are still retained by the admission path; nothing is lost except unearned trust. MEASURED SEMANTICS RECORDED FOR THE NEXT REVIEWER. Fifty rows of a bare read carried, on every row: mint, name, symbol, creator, complete, initialized, created_timestamp, market_cap, market_cap_quote, market_cap_usd, usd_market_cap, reply_count, virtual_sol_reserves, virtual_token_reserves, virtual_quote_reserves, real_sol_reserves, real_token_reserves, real_quote_reserves, total_supply, total_supply_str, base_decimals, quote_decimals, bonding_curve, associated_bonding_curve, pool_address, token_program, quote_mint, program, protocol, chain_id, multichain_family, nsfw, is_banned, is_currently_live, verified, boost_mode, hide_banner, show_name, is_cashback_enabled, livestream_ban_expiry, description, image_uri, metadata_uri and username. Present on thirty-eight of fifty: last_trade_timestamp, updated_at, ath_market_cap and ath_market_cap_timestamp, which is to say a coin that has never traded simply has no such keys rather than nulls. UNITS HAZARD: created_timestamp, last_trade_timestamp and ath_market_cap_timestamp are epoch MILLISECONDS and updated_at alone is epoch SECONDS. Read as milliseconds updated_at lands in January 1970, which reads as a plausible stale record rather than as a units error, and this reviewer made exactly that mistake before checking. TWO FIELDS CLAIM THE SAME THING AND DISAGREE: market_cap_usd and usd_market_cap differ on essentially every row, by a median of 0.10 percent and up to 0.31 percent over 140 measured rows, presumably because they were computed against different SOL price snapshots. Neither is preferred here and nothing downstream may silently pick one. RESERVES GO STALE ON GRADUATION: a coin with complete=true was observed carrying virtual_sol_reserves=30000000000 and real_sol_reserves=0, the launch constants, while its market cap moved by 97 percent inside ninety-seven seconds, so price may not be derived from reserves once a coin has bonded. WHAT IS NOT HERE: no volume, no trade count, no holder count, no buy/sell split, no price at any earlier instant. This review was made by an agent, not by Ember. It authorises nothing.
